sentences.en: He told the delegates what they already knew was true.
sentences.zh: 他告诉代表们他们已经知道的事实。

sentences.en: They were delegates from India to the U. N.
sentences.zh: 他们是来自印度的联合国代表团成员。

sentences.en: Micromanagers often find it very hard to delegate work to others.
sentences.zh: micromanagers 往往很难把工作委派给他人。

senses.zh: 代理人，代表：representative for another；移交（权力，任务等）：

mnemonic: de（加强）+leg（法律）+ate→加强法律之人→代表
